articles.title: Argentina set to go to Cas after Fifa rejects appeals
articles.summary: The Argentina Football Association says it is planning to go to the Court of Arbitration for Sport over Fifa rejecting its appeals against World Cup punishments.

articles.title: Rybakina pulls out of 2026 WTA Finals at Indian Wells
articles.summary: Defending champion Elena Rybakina has withdrawal from the 2026 WTA Finals on the eve of the season-ending tournament citing a medical issue.
